notes: Fiscal year ended January 31, 2025 (Salesforce calls it fiscal 2025; matches data.js fy 'Jan 2025'). Documents read on sec.gov: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001108524-25-000006) and 2025 proxy statement (DEF 14A, accession 0001108524-25-000009). Salesforce paid its first dividends in fiscal 2025. XBRL also carries $1,549 million of dividends declared (DividendsCommonStockCash); the cash-flow figure of $1,537 million paid is used. Benioff's 22,796,932 shares include 827,475 shares from options and PRSUs vesting within 60 days and 10,000,000 shares held by the Marc Benioff Fund LLC. Holder asOf dates are the Schedule 13G filing dates the proxy cites; it does not give event dates. The Vanguard and BlackRock figures date from early 2024. GEOGRAPHY: the 10-K says Americas revenue attributed to the United States was about 93% in each year.
